<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="center"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">PART I</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">
<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 85px"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><a name="iterm1">ITEM 1.</a></font></td>
<td width="896"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">BUSINESS</font></td>
</tr></table>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">General</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Tii Network Technologies, Inc. and subsidiaries (together, &#8220;Tii,&#8221; the &#8220;company,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us&#8221; or &#8220;our&#8221;) design, manufacture and sell products to service providers in the communications industry for use in their networks.&#160; We sell our products through a network of sales channels, principally to telephone operating companies (&#8220;Telcos&#8221;), multi-system operators (&#8220;MSOs&#8221;) of communications services, including cable and satellite service providers, and original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs").&#160;&#160;Our products are typically found in the Telcos central offices, outdoors in the service providers&#8217; distribution network, at the interface where the service providers&#8217; network connects to the users&#8217; network, and inside the users&#8217; home or apartment, and are critical to the successful delivery of voice and broadband communication services.</font><br>
&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our corporate headquarters are located in a building that we own in Edgewood, New York.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Recent Acquisitions</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">On May&#160;19, 2010, we acquired all of the assets, exclusive of cash, and assumed certain operating liabilities, primarily accounts payable and accrued expenses, of the Copper Products Division of Porta Systems Corp. (the &#8220;Porta Copper Products Division&#8221;) for cash of $8,150,000, plus subsequent purchase price adjustments totaling $99,000, for a total purchase price of $8,249,000.&#160;&#160;The Porta Copper Products Division was comprised of two wholly owned subsidiaries, one in England and the other in Mexico, as well as domestic assets and liabilities exclusively related to copper telecommunications products.&#160;&#160;Concurrent with this acquisition, we sold the acquired Mexican subsidiary, exclusive of customer contracts and certain machinery and equipment which we retained, to our principal contract manufacturer, that is now operating this manufacturing facility, for $1,000,000, subject to a subsequent working capital reduction.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our financial statements for the year ended December&#160;31, 2010 include the activity of the Porta Copper Products Division since May&#160;20, 2010.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">On March 11, 2011, we acquired 100% of the capital stock of Frederick Fiber Optics (&#8220;F2O&#8221;) for an initial cash payment made from cash on hand and incentive payments to be made based on the achievement of certain performance objectives over the next two years.&#160;&#160;F2O, headquartered in Frederick, Maryland, manufactures a wide variety of high performance fiber optic cable assemblies, wall and rack mounted fiber distribution panels, and miscellaneous fiber accessories and services.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Products</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Network Interface Devices (&#8220;NID&#8221;), Building Entrance Terminals (&#8220;BET&#8221;) and Accessories</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Telco NIDs and BETs house the demarcation point between the public switched telephone network (PSTN) provider and the customer&#8217;s network. They are provided with primary protectors that meet or exceed National Electric Code requirements for incoming communications lines, as well as customer demarcation, customer termination ports, and various electronic circuits. Building Entrance Terminals (&#8220;BETs&#8221;) are used in larger line pair environments such as condos, apartments, and office buildings.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Network Interface Devices:</font>&#160;&#160;A NID is typically a thermoplastic box located on the outside of a customer&#8217;s premise, housing primary surge protectors, customer demarcation, customer termination ports and various electronic circuits. It is ruggedized against the environment and has both Telco and customer access points. Our family of 1, 2, 3, 6 and 12 line NIDs is designed to comply with rigorous industry environmental and electrical performance standards.&#160;&#160;Our NIDs usually incorporate a variety of components including our overvoltage surge protectors, Digital Subscriber Line (&#8220;DSL&#8221;) service splitters for broadband delivery, and customer bridge modules which facilitate</font></font></div>

<br>
<div id="PGBRK" style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: effontselection; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">6</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<br>
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">customer access to the network. Our NIDs are used in single family and small multi-dwelling unit (&#8220;MDU&#8221;) applications.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Building Entrance Terminals:</font> A BET is a sheet metal enclosure located either inside or outside of an MDU or commercial building, housing primary surge protectors in a 5 pin format, as well as connectivity for incoming and outgoing multi-pair bundles of copper communication wire. BETs come in a variety of connectivity and enclosure options, with typical line counts of 25, 50, and 100 pairs, with the ability to stack multiple units for larger pair counts.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font id="TAB1" style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"></font><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Accessories</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">:</font>&#160;&#160;Tii designs and manufactures a broad range of products designed to operate in our NIDs, as well as our competitor&#8217;s NIDs. These products include station protectors, customer wiring modules to interconnect service to the home, DSL service splitters, Electro-Magnetic Interference (EMI) filters and line test modules, which enable remote testing of the integrity of the service providers&#8217; lines, minimizing costly maintenance dispatches.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Broadband Products</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our broadband products facilitate the successful deployment of Triple Play services (voice, video and data) and are comprised of both active electronics and passive components. These products enable service providers to offer the most stable and highest bandwidth services safely to the user at the lowest deployment cost.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Digital Subscriber Line Technology:</font>&#160;&#160;Telcos have been utilizing their existing infrastructure of copper access wires to deliver broadband services with DSL technology.&#160;&#160;We have developed an extensive line of DSL electronic products for this market, including a line of xDSL POTS (Plain Old Telephone Service) Splitters.&#160;&#160;These splitters isolate the voice and data signals on a Telco line to provide separate outputs for phone and data services which enables DSL services. Modules are available in several NID configurations, as well as several indoor units.&#160;&#160;Our products also allow DSL signals to coexist with door entry/intercom systems and monitored alarm systems.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;Intelligent NID:</font>&#160;&#160;Our outdoor intelligent residential gateway Outrigger<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 70%; VERTICAL-ALIGN: text-top">TM</font>, now sometimes referred to as an &#8220;iNID,&#8221; facilitates the delivery of Triple-Play bundled services &#8211; digital telephone, television and Internet data by telephone or cable service providers.&#160;&#160;Our current configuration accomplishes this by embedding the Home Phone Network Alliance (&#8220;HPNA&#8221;) technology for delivering Internet Protocol (&#8220;IP&#8221;) technologies to customers over a home&#8217;s existing cable TV (COAX) or telephone wiring, eliminating the need to run new dedicated CAT5 Ethernet cabling to provide Triple-Play services.&#160;&#160;Our expertise in this area has enabled us to sell key component parts to companies delivering similar products.</font><br>
&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">HomePlug&#174;:</font> HomePlug&#174; technology enables networking of voice, data and audio devices through the consumers&#8217; AC power lines. Our HomePlug&#174;-compatible and HomePlug&#174;-embedded surge protectors incorporate our patented and proprietary AC protection, filtering and HomePlug&#174; Powerline integrated circuits.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Connectivity Products</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Connectivity products include both active and passive solutions that incorporate superior wire management, technician friendly &#8220;tool-less&#8221; design, insulation displacement contact (&#8220;IDC&#8221;) and gel-sealed options.&#160;&#160;These products are designed to support broadband-enabled services and network management.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Connector Block and Terminal Block Products</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">:</font>&#160;These products connect large numbers of copper interconnects with or without protection, typically utilizing tooless punch down IDC technology or wire wrapping. The products are used by telephone and data equipment companies to connect copper lines, most commonly in a Telco Central Office or in a field distribution cabinet.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Voice over Internet Protocol (&#8220;VoIP&#8221;) Products</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">:</font> These solutions provide Telco &#8220;NID &#8211; like&#8221; environmentally robust enclosures and advanced gel sealed wire termination products for connection of broadband delivered VoIP telephony service. An extensive range of connectivity solutions is offered for single family, MDU and commercial applications.</font></font></div>

<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">&#160; </font></div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<br>
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Switchable Voice NID (&#8220;SVN&#8221;) Products:</font>&#160;&#160;These solutions enable the efficient installation and connection of VoIP telephony to cable subscribers and include SVNs which remotely activate VoIP telephony.&#160;&#160;Units are available for single family, multiple dwelling unit and commercial applications.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Voice Intercom Systems (&#8220;VIS&#8221;) Products:</font>&#160;&#160;These products are used in MDUs for telephony delivered via cable, fiber or DSL VoIP to enable the newly installed telephone service to work with Gate Entry and Door Entry Intercom systems which are typically disconnected when broadband services are deployed.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Wire Terminals and Other Connectivity: </font>These<font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font>products include various wire connectivity solutions for telephony and category 5 wiring. The products include aerial terminals and enclosures that provide world class performance in extremely harsh outdoor environments and are located throughout the service providers&#8217; network, typically deployed in aerial locations.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Fiber Optic Products</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Fiber Optic Products include both active and passive solutions to aid service providers (Telco, MSO and other providers) in their deployment of Fiber To The Home (&#8220;FTTH&#8221;) and Fiber to the Node (&#8220;FTTN&#8221;) networks. These deployments typically utilize an Optical Network Terminals (&#8220;ONT&#8221;) to convert light pulses from a fiber optic line into electrical pulses. Other Fiber Optic Products are sold by us for use in commercial or business fiber deployments, data centers, and Central Office applications for wireline and wireless service providers. We have recently expanded our fiber optic product offerings as a result of our acquisition of F2O completed in March 2011.&#160;&#160;This discussion is inclusive of these new products.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Wall Mount Enclosures:</font>&#160;Wall mount fiber enclosures are typically installed inside a building and serve to transition from outdoor to indoor fiber using a fusion splice. They store slack of both the indoor and outdoor fibers, constrain and protect the fusion splices, and provide a connectorized demarcation point for indoor patching and testing using a handheld meter to verify signal integrity. This family of products is designed for 6, 12, 24, 48, or 96 fibers, and is available with a wide variety of adapter plates, splice trays, and custom fiber cable assemblies.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Rack Mount Enclosures:</font>&#160;Rack mount fiber enclosures perform essentially the same function as wall mount enclosures for customers who prefer to use equipment racks. This family of products is designed for 6, 12, 24, 48, or 96 fibers, and is available with a wide variety of adapter plates, splice trays, and custom fiber cable assemblies.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">OSP Fiber Enclosures:</font> These products consist of a thermoplastic box located on the outside of a customer&#8217;s premise or MDU, and are used for in FTTH and FTTN deployments. A service provider will use these enclosures to protect fiber splices made in the field, provide a demarcation/fiber test port for verifying signal integrity, and to allow transition from outdoor rated fiber to indoor rated fiber. They are designed to comply with rigorous industry environmental and electrical performance standards and several products are available for up to 12 fibers.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Cable Assemblies:</font> These products consist of custom fiber cable assemblies and standard length fiber patch cords. The custom fiber cables are built using virtually any fiber type, length, and connector type such as SC, FC, LC, ST, MTP/MPO and more exotic types. These custom assemblies are typically of very high quality and performance, and are built to order with a lead time of 2 days to 2 weeks. Standard length fiber patch cords of various lengths and connector types are also provided.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Miscellaneous Fiber Accessories:</font> These products consist of various custom assembles containing fiber optic components such as optical couplers, splitters, attenuators. Fiber cleaning supplies, test equipment, and field services are also offered.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">ONT Installation Accessories</font>:</font> We provide various connectivity modules typically utilized inside Optic Network Terminals (&#8220;ONTs&#8221;) and active electronic devices to enable the fiber delivered telephone service to coexist with Gate Entry and Door Entry Intercom systems. We also provide a grounding and overvoltage protection device used in the deployment of ONTs by service providers.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">&#160; </font></div>

<br>
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Overvoltage Surge Protection</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Surge protection products are used by major telecommunications providers at the Central Office, remote DSL pedestals and subscriber locations, protecting both personnel and network plant equipment, while increasing field service reliability and reducing maintenance costs.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Gas Tubes:</font> Our gas tubes represent the foundation upon which most of our overvoltage surge protector products are based. Our proprietary two and three electrode gas tubes have been designed to withstand multiple high-energy overvoltage surges while continuing to provide a long service life.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Modular Station Protectors:</font> Our broad line of station overvoltage surge protectors are designed to be deployed in a variety of configurations to accommodate service providers&#8217; requirements.&#160;&#160;Our most advanced overvoltage surge protector incorporates sealed Insulation Displacement Connector (&#8220;IDC&#8221;) &#8220;tool-less&#8221; connections, which reduce installation time, increase reliability and are ideally suited for today&#8217;s high speed broadband service networks.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Protector Modules:</font>&#160;Protector Modules are used to protect equipment and personnel from electrical surges in Central Office applications, BETs, remote distribution cabinets, and FTTN DSL pedestals.&#160;&#160;The product line consists of industry standard 1 and 5 pin protector modules, with one module used for each copper twisted pair that requires protection. The protector modules utilize various technologies including Gas Discharge Tube, solid state, and optionally include current limiting devices such as heat coils and positive temperature coefficient resistors.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Protector Packs and Cat 5 Cat 6 Protection:</font>&#160;Products in this category are primarily designed to protect copper wires used in data and PBX applications. They contain connectivity for multiple wire pairs, and accommodate 1 or 5 pin protector modules. They are typically used for protecting Cat 5 or 6 Ethernet connections, or any other type of communication system that utilizes copper wire.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Other Surge Protection Products:&#160;&#160;</font>We design and manufacture a variety of other surge protection devices that include a patented high-performance 75 ohm coaxial protector for cable networks, a 50-ohm coaxial protector for wireless service providers&#8217; cell sites, a gel-sealed Ethernet data protector and power line/data line protectors for personal computers and home entertainment systems.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Product Development</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We focus our product development resources on products that providers of communication services need to more effectively deliver their services.&#160;&#160;Our customers maintain highly complex networks, and many of the products we develop are the result of discussions we have with our customers.&#160;&#160;An important aspect of our product development is that we also invest our resources to develop products in anticipation of the future network strategies of our customers.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our research and development (&#8220;R&amp;D&#8221;) strategy includes developing products internally, as well as with contract engineers, technology partners and contract manufacturers.&#160;&#160;Our R&amp;D engineers work closely with our contract manufacturer during the design and development phase of all products.</font><br>
&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our R&amp;D department is skilled and experienced in various technical disciplines, including physics, electrical, mechanical and software design, with specialization in such fields as plastics, electronics, metallurgy and chemistry.&#160;&#160;We also use contract engineers skilled in specific design tasks.&#160;&#160;Our contract manufacturer is similarly skilled in these R&amp;D fields, with engineering and manufacturing expertise to bring a product of the highest quality to market on time at a competitive price.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">For the years ended December&#160;31, 2010, 2009 and 2008, R&amp;D expense was $2,239,000, $1,590,000 and $2,040,000, respectively.&#160;&#160;The largest portion of our development efforts is focused on new products for the growth segments of the Telco and MSO markets, primarily broadband and fiber deployment.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Telco customers represented approximately 94%, 89% and 87% of our net sales for the years ended December&#160;31, 2010, 2009 and 2008, respectively.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Sales of our products to certain of our principal customers are generally through &#8220;as-ordered&#8221; general supply agreements.&#160;&#160;General supply agreements do not require Telcos to purchase specific quantities of products and can be terminated for various reasons, including without cause by either party, or extended by mutual written agreement. Prices, warranties, benefits, terms and conditions granted to customers under these general supply agreements are fixed, but must be at least as favorable as those granted by Tii to other commercial customers under like or similar circumstances.&#160;&#160;Purchases of our products are generally based on individual customer purchase orders for delivery from inventory or within thirty days.&#160;&#160;We, therefore, have no material firm backlog of orders.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We believe that our products offer superior, cost-effective performance, features and characteristics, including high reliability, long life cycles, ease of installation and optimum protection against adverse environmental conditions.&#160;&#160;We believe that this, together with responsive customer service, reduces the risks inherent in &#8220;as-ordered&#8221; contracts.&#160;&#160;We further believe that our superior products and customer care, attributes which have attracted and maintained our Telco business, will enhance our ability to expand into other target markets.&#160;&#160;The Porta Copper Products Division acquisition provided products and sales channels for the Central Office, OSP and Customer Premise markets, markets in which we historically have had a relatively small presence.&#160;&#160;These products include building entrance terminals, cable assemblies and surge protection modules.&#160;&#160;With the recent acquisition of F2O, we significantly expanded our fiber optic product offering while leveraging our existing and well established sales channels to our customers.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">International Markets</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Over the past several years, we had been seeking to expand sales of our products into international markets.&#160;&#160;Prior to our Porta Copper Products Division acquisition, sales into foreign markets had been made primarily to Canada, in addition to countries in the Caribbean, South and Central America, the Pacific Rim and other parts of Europe.&#160;&#160;With the acquisition of the Porta Copper Products Division, we added significant Telcos in both England and Mexico to our customer base.&#160;&#160;Our international sales were approximately $23.2 million (43% of sales), $5.1 million (19% of </font></div>

Excluding sales to our customer in England, which are denominated in Pound Sterling, and sales to our customer in Mexico, which are billed in U.S. dollars and paid in Mexican Pesos, we require foreign sales to be paid for in U.S. currency.&#160;&#160;International sales are affected by such factors as the North American Free Trade Agreement (&#8220;NAFTA&#8221;) and Central American Free Trade Agreement (&#8220;CAFTA&#8221;) requirements, exchange rates, changes in protective tariffs and foreign government import controls.&#160;&#160;We believe international markets continue to offer additional opportunities for our products and we continue to actively pursue these markets.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Manufacturing</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We run a quick-response, low volume manufacturing operation from our headquarters in Edgewood, New York.&#160; All high volume production is outsourced and is produced by our contract manufacturer located in China and Mexico.&#160;&#160;This contract manufacturer utilizes, in most cases, our equipment and processes.&#160; We depend on our contract manufacturer to produce the majority of our products for sale to our customers.&#160;&#160;There is a strict non-disclosure agreement in place with our contract manufacturer.&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">All product manufactured in China is approved by Tii prior to shipping out of China using Acceptable Quality Level (&#8220;AQL&#8221;) sampling procedures and on site auditing by Tii quality personnel located in our China Quality Assurance laboratory. This laboratory holds the same TL9000 certificate as Tii and reports directly to our Quality Vice President. Our primary contract manufacturer is an independent U.S. based corporation with a wholly owned subsidiary located in China that is listed by Underwriters Laboratories (&#8220;UL&#8221;) and is TL9000 qualified and registered.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Concurrent with the Porta Copper Products Division acquisition in May 2010, we sold the acquired Mexican subsidiary, exclusive of customer contracts and certain machinery and equipment which we retained, to our principal contract manufacturer, which is now operating this manufacturing facility and supplying us product from this facility.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We terminated our agreement with another contract manufacturer in Malaysia, which produced most of our proprietary gas tubes, effective December 20, 2010, with the sourcing of these products being transitioned to our principal contract manufacturer in China.&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Raw Materials</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">The primary components of our products are stamped, drawn and formed parts made out of a variety of commonly available metals, ceramics and plastics.&#160;&#160;The manufacturer of our overvoltage surge protectors and station electronic products use commonly available components, printed circuit boards and standard electrical components, such as resistors, diodes and capacitors.&#160;&#160;All orders with suppliers of the components utilized in the manufacture of our products are scheduled for delivery within a year.&#160;&#160;Our products contain a significant amount of plastic that is manufactured out of petroleum, brass and other alloys that contain copper and steel.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Competition</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We face significant competition across all of our markets and product lines.&#160;&#160;Our principal competitors within the Telco market are Corning Cable Systems LLC, Tyco Electronics Corp, which is also our customer, and Bourns, Inc.&#160;&#160;Our principal competition within the MSO market is Tyco Electronics Corp and Channell Commercial Corporation.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Principal competitive factors within our markets include price, technology, product features, service, quality, reliability and bringing new products to market on time.&#160;&#160;Compared to our business and operations, most of our competitors have substantially greater financial, sales, manufacturing and product development resources.&#160;&#160;Our reputation among our customers is one of providing swift responses to their needs with creative and effective solutions, using products compliant with, and in most cases superior in performance to, the demanding specifications of customers.&#160;&#160;This approach, combined with our history of continually improving technology, improved operations and effective collaborations, allows us to bring product solutions to our customers quickly and at competitive prices.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We believe that these factors, together with our high quality products and service, our contract manufacturer&#8217;s low cost production capabilities, our engineering resources and our overvoltage surge protection technology enable us to maintain our competitive position.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Patent and Trademarks</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We own or have applied for a number of patents relating to certain of our products or product components and own a number of registered trademarks that are considered to be of value, principally in identifying Tii and our products.&#160;&#160;TII&#174;, Porta Systems&#174;, In-Line&#174;, Totel Failsafe&#174;, and Angle Driver&#174;&#160;are among our registered trademarks. While we consider our patents and trademarks to be important, especially in the early stages of product marketing, we believe that, because of technological advances in our industry, our success depends primarily upon our sales, engineering and manufacturing skills and effective development collaborations which have accelerated the time-to-market of improved and new products.&#160;&#160;To maintain our industry position, we rely primarily on technical leadership, trade secrets, our proprietary technology and our contract manufacturer&#8217;s low cost production capabilities and engineering resources.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Government Regulation</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">The Telcos and MSOs are subject to regulation in the United States and in other countries.&#160;&#160;In the United States, the FCC and various state public service or utility commissions regulate most of the Telcos and other communications access providers who use our products.&#160;&#160;While those regulations do not typically apply directly to us, the effects of those regulations, which are under continuous review and subject to change, could adversely affect our customers and, ultimately, Tii.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">The National Electric Code (&#8220;NEC&#8221;) of the United States requires that an overvoltage surge protector listed by UL or another qualified electrical testing laboratory be installed on all traditional Telco copper subscriber telephone lines that are exposed to lightning and accidental contact with electric light or power conductors. We have traditionally obtained and maintained listing by UL where required.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Compliance with applicable Federal, state and local environmental regulations has not had, and we do not believe that compliance in the future will have, a material adverse effect on our earnings, capital expenditures or competitive position.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Employees</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">As of March&#160;29, 2011, we had approximately 75 full-time employees.&#160;&#160;We have not experienced any work stoppage as a result of labor difficulties and believe we have satisfactory employee relations.&#160;&#160;We are not a party to any collective bargaining agreements.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Seasonality</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our operations are subject to seasonal variations, primarily due to the fact that our principal products, NIDs,&#160;are&#160;typically installed on the side of homes.&#160;&#160;During the hurricane season, sales may increase based on the severity and location of hurricanes and the number of NIDs that are damaged and need replacement. &#160;Conversely, during&#160;winter&#160;months when severe weather&#160;hinders or delays the Telco&#8217;s installation&#160;and maintenance of their&#160;outside plant network, NID sales have been adversely affected until replacements can be installed (at which time sales increase).</font></div>

<td width="896"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">RISK FACTORS</font></td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">An investment in our common stock involves a number of risks.&#160;&#160;Our business and future operating results may be affected by many risks, uncertainties and other factors, including those set forth below.&#160;&#160;These factors could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and prospects. As a result, the market price of our common stock could decline and you could lose all or part of your investment.&#160;&#160;The risks, uncertainties and other factors described in this Report are not the only ones we face.&#160;&#160;There may be additional risks, uncertainties and other factors that we do not currently consider material or that are not presently known to us.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Risks Relating To Our Business</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">We have certain contractual limitations on price increases, which coupled with increased commodities costs and pricing pressures, could adversely affect our gross profit margins.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Pricing pressures in the markets in which we operate are intense due in part to the consolidation of various telephone companies and their resulting purchasing power.&#160;&#160;Our general supply contracts generally prohibit us from increasing the price of our products to be sold under the contract for stated periods of time.&#160;&#160;Accordingly, any significant increase in our costs during those periods, without offsetting price increases, could adversely affect our gross profit margins.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Economic conditions may continue to adversely affect consumers and our customers and suppliers, thereby adversely affecting our financial performance, results of operations and financial condition.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">The global economic environment since 2008 has resulted in reduced credit lending by banks, solvency concerns of major financial institutions and others, high unemployment levels and significant declines and volatility in the global financial markets.&#160;&#160;The credit crisis had caused our customers to reduce inventories in 2008 and into 2009, which resulted in reduced purchases from suppliers such as us, and certain customers continue to aggressively seek pricing concessions.&#160;&#160;These factors have a negative impact on the level of consumer spending.&#160;&#160;Certain of the products offered by our customers - service providers in the communications industry - are dependent on consumer spending which, in turn, impacts the demand of the service providers for our products.&#160;&#160;These actions have impacted, and a continuance of these factors in the future could impact, our sales and profit margins.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Our primary market, the traditional Telco copper-based transmission network, has been declining over the last several years.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Principally due to the competitive impact of alternative technologies that compete with the Telco&#8217;s traditional copper-based transmission network, such as cellular service and Fiber-To-The-Premises (&#8220;FTTP&#8221;), and competition from MSOs, over the past several years there have been cutbacks in copper-based construction and maintenance budgets by the Telcos and a reduction in the number of their access lines.&#160;&#160;As a result, our principal copper-based business has been adversely affected.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">In this regard, one of our principal customers continues its strategy to deploy FTTP.&#160;&#160;This multi-year program has resulted in a reduction of capital outlays for its traditional copper network and has, therefore, impacted our traditional protection based products since FTTP networks require less traditional protection than current copper networks.&#160;&#160;Also, this customer has taken actions to reduce its footprint by bundling telephone lines in certain territories and offering them for sale, and there is no guarantee that we will continue to provide products to the service provider that might buy these lines previously serviced by this customer.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Though landlines, in general, continue to be dropped by customers as a result of the introduction and acceptance of new technologies, current economic conditions are accelerating this trend.&#160;&#160;While we believe that the current embedded copper infrastructure will continue to play a significant role as a transmission medium for years to come, it is likely to continue to decline year to year.&#160;&#160;Further, there can be no assurance that this trend will not accelerate.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">A relatively small number of customers collectively account for a significant amount of our revenue.&#160;&#160;Our three largest customers accounted for approximately 51% of our revenue in 2010 and almost 60% of our revenue during 2009 and 2008.&#160;&#160;Other customers have, from time to time, accounted for more than 10% of our revenues in a year.&#160;&#160;See Item 1, &#8220;Business &#8211; Marketing and Sales.&#8221;&#160;&#160;We expect that, at least in the near term, we will continue to rely on our success in selling our existing and future products to these customers in significant quantities.&#160;&#160;There can be no assurance that we will be able to retain our largest customers or that we will be able to obtain additional customers or replace key customers we may lose or who may reduce their purchases from us.&#160;&#160;The loss of one or more of these customers, or a substantial diminution in orders received from these customers, could have a material adverse effect on us. </font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">We are subject to foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our acquisition of the Porta Copper Products Division has increased our exposure to currency exchange rate fluctuations because a larger portion of our revenues, a portion of our expenses and certain assets and liabilities are translated into U.S. dollars for financial reporting purposes.&#160;&#160;In addition, our principal contract manufacturer operates facilities in China and Mexico.&#160;&#160;Accordingly, a reduction in the value of non-U.S. dollar currencies, principally the Pound Sterling, Chinese Yuan and Mexican Peso relative to the U.S. dollar, or changes in the relative value of currencies that we use for transactions, could have a material adverse affect on our financial condition and results of operations.&#160;&#160;We may seek to mitigate our exposure to currency exchange rate fluctuations through currency hedging and other means, but our efforts may not be successful.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">We are dependent upon suppliers of product components, the loss of whom could result in manufacturing and delivery delays, affect our ability to obtain components and increase prices to us.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our principal contract manufacturer provides the components necessary to produce products for us.&#160;&#160;Generally they have no long-term supply contracts.&#160;&#160;Although we believe that substantially all components and supplies used will continue to be available in adequate quantities at competitive prices, we cannot assure you that we will not experience the absence of components or supplies, delays in obtaining their delivery or increases in prices in the future.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Recent events in Japan could impact our operations.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">Our principal contract manufacturer sources certain raw materials from a vendor headquartered in Japan with factories located in various locations throughout Asia, including Japan, Taiwan and Korea.&#160;&#160;Although there has been no current impact to our supply chain as a result of the recent disaster in Japan, and we believe that these raw materials will continue to be available in adequate quantities at competitive prices, we cannot assure you that we will not experience the absence of components or supplies, delays in obtaining their delivery or increases in prices in the future as the impact of the disaster in Japan unfolds.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Our credit facility imposes restrictions on certain aspects of our business and our ability to obtain additional financing which may affect our ability to grow.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We currently have a credit facility in the amount of $5,000,000.&#160;&#160;The revolving credit facility is limited by a borrowing base, in general, equal to 80% of eligible accounts receivable, plus the lesser of 30% of eligible inventory, after certain reserves, or $1,500,000. At December 31, 2010, our borrowing base was in excess of $5,000,000.&#160;&#160;The credit agreement contains various covenants, including financial covenants and covenants that prohibit or limit a variety of actions without the bank's consent. These include, among other things, covenants that prohibit the payment of dividends and limit our ability to repurchase our stock, incur or guarantee indebtedness, create liens, purchase all or a substantial part of the assets or stock of another entity, other than certain permitted acquisitions, create or acquire any subsidiary, or substantially change our business.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">If we fail to comply with the covenants in our credit agreement, our bank lender may prohibit us from making future borrowings and may declare any borrowings outstanding at the time to become due and payable immediately.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">If the amount we may borrow under the credit facility is not sufficient for our needs, we may require financing from other sources, which we may not be able to obtain until the credit facility is terminated.&#160;&#160;Our inability to obtain financing could have a material adverse effect on our ability to expand our business.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Accounting rules for share-based compensation may adversely affect our operating results, our stock price and our competitiveness in the employee marketplace.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We have a history of using employee stock options and restricted stock awards to hire, motivate and retain our employees. Accounting literature requires us to measure compensation costs for all share-based compensation, including stock options and restricted stock awards, at fair value and to recognize these costs as expenses in our statements of income.&#160;&#160;Although not a cash expense, the recognition of these expenses in our statements of income has had, and is expected to continue to have, a negative effect on our reported earnings and earnings per share, which could negatively impact our future stock price.&#160;&#160;In addition, if we reduce or alter our use of share-based compensation to minimize the recognition of these expenses, our ability to recruit, motivate and retain employees may be impaired, which could put us at a competitive disadvantage in the employee marketplace.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">The costs that we incur and management time we expend as a result of being a public company could increase significantly in the future.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We incur significant legal, accounting, administrative and other costs and expenses as a public company. We are required to comply with rules and regulations promulgated by the SEC and NASDAQ. Compliance with these rules and regulations causes us to incur legal, audit and financial compliance costs, and diverts management&#8217;s attention from operations and strategic opportunities.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">In 2007, we incurred significant initial costs in evaluating and reporting on our internal control over financial reporting as required by Section&#160;404(a) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 (&#8220;SOX&#8221;) and related rules and regulations of the SEC and standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB).&#160;&#160;The process of assessing and testing our internal controls and complying with Section&#160;404 is ongoing and has been, and will continue to be, time consuming, and it requires significant management attention.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">As a smaller reporting company (defined as having a market capitalization less than $75 million) we are currently exempt from needing an independent auditor test and report on the effectiveness of our internal controls over financial reporting.&#160;&#160;However, if in the future our status as a smaller reporting company were to change, we will incur additional costs when our independent registered public accounting firm would be required, under Section 404(b) of SOX, to audit the effectiveness of our internal controls over financial reporting.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We reported our report on internal control over financial reporting in Item 9A, &#8220;Controls and Procedures.&#8221;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">The success of the acquisitions of the Porta Copper Products Division and F2O will depend on our solidifying relationships with their pre-existing customers.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">The success of the acquisitions of the Porta Copper Products Division and F2O will be dependent on our ability to maintain and renew relationships with the pre-existing customers of both the Porta Copper Products Division and F2O.&#160;&#160;There can be no assurance that we will be able to maintain pre-existing customer contracts and other business relationships, or enter into or maintain new customer contracts and other business relationships, on acceptable terms, if at all.&#160;&#160;The failure to maintain important customer relationships could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">The acquisition of F2O may not be accretive and may cause dilution to our earnings, which could negatively impact the price of our common stock following the completion of the acquisition.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt"><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt">We anticipate that the acquisition of F2O will be accretive to our earnings beginning with the third quarter of 2011.&#160;&#160;This expectation is based on preliminary estimates and assumes certain synergies expected to be realized by the combined company within that timeframe.&#160;&#160;These estimates and assumptions could materially change due to additional transaction and integration related costs, the failure to realize any or all of the benefits expected in the acquisition and other factors beyond our control.&#160;&#160;All of these factors could delay, decrease or eliminate the expected accretive effect of the acquisition and cause a resulting reduction to our earnings, thereby adversely affecting the market price of our common stock<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">.</font></font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">The anti-takeover provisions in our certificate of incorporation and under Delaware law may discourage or prevent takeover offers which could increase the price of our stock if those provisions did not exist.</font></div>

<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">MANAGEMENT&#8217;S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS</font></div>
